description: Demolition of the existing building and redevelopment of the site to provide 250 residential units (Use Class C3) within 6 buildings ranging from 4 to 7 storeys. Provision of new pedestrian route and access link, private amenity space, communal amenity and podium gardens, refuse storage, 63 car parking spaces and 457 cycle parking spaces, energy centre, substation building and other associated facilities
